WITH RAW_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TRIM(
            CAST(
                @{item().partition_column}
                AS VARCHAR(100)
            )
        ) AS RAW_VAL
    FROM
        @{if(
            empty(trim(coalesce(item().cdc_tgt_schema_nm, ''))),
            item().src_schema_nm,
            item().cdc_tgt_schema_nm
        )}.@{item().src_table_nm}
),

DISTINCT_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT
        CASE

            /* 1. STRING + MONTHLY */
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_data_type, '')}')) = 'string'
             AND LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')) = 'monthly'
            THEN RAW_VAL

            /* 2. STRING + YEARLY */
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_data_type, '')}')) = 'string'
             AND LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')) = 'yearly'
            THEN LEFT(RAW_VAL, 4)

            /* 3. DATE/TIMESTAMP + MONTHLY */
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_data_type, '')}'))
                    IN ('date', 'timestamp')
             AND LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')) = 'monthly'
            THEN REPLACE(
                    LEFT(RAW_VAL, 7),
                    '-',
                    ''
                 )

            /* 4. DATE/TIMESTAMP + YEARLY */
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_data_type, '')}'))
                    IN ('date', 'timestamp')
             AND LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')) = 'yearly'
            THEN LEFT(RAW_VAL, 4)

            ELSE NULL
        END AS PARTITION_VAL,

        CASE

            /* STRING + MONTHLY */
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_data_type, '')}')) = 'string'
             AND LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')) = 'monthly'
            THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN RAW_VAL IS NOT NULL
                     AND REGEXP_LIKE(
                            RAW_VAL,
                            '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$'
                         )
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            /* STRING + YEARLY */
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_data_type, '')}')) = 'string'
             AND LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')) = 'yearly'
            THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN RAW_VAL IS NOT NULL
                     AND
                     (
                         REGEXP_LIKE(
                             RAW_VAL,
                             '^[0-9]{4}$'
                         )

                         OR

                         REGEXP_LIKE(
                             RAW_VAL,
                             '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$'
                         )
                     )
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            /* DATE / TIMESTAMP */
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_data_type, '')}'))
                    IN ('date', 'timestamp')
            THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN RAW_VAL IS NULL
                    THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END

            ELSE 0
        END AS VALID_YN

    FROM RAW_PARTITION
),

VALID_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        PARTITION_VAL
    FROM DISTINCT_PARTITION
    WHERE VALID_YN = 1

      AND
      (
          TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_from, '')}') = ''

          OR

          PARTITION_VAL >=
              CASE
                  WHEN LOWER(
                           TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')
                       ) = 'yearly'
                  THEN LEFT(
                           TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_from, '')}'),
                           4
                       )
                  ELSE
                       TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_from, '')}')
              END
      )

      AND
      (
          TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_to, '')}') = ''

          OR

          PARTITION_VAL <=
              CASE
                  WHEN LOWER(
                           TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')
                       ) = 'yearly'
                  THEN LEFT(
                           TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_to, '')}'),
                           4
                       )
                  ELSE
                       TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_to, '')}')
              END
      )
),

RESULT_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT
        PARTITION_VAL AS PARTITION_ID
    FROM VALID_PARTITION

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'INVALID' AS PARTITION_ID
    FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1
    WHERE EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM DISTINCT_PARTITION
        WHERE VALID_YN = 0
    )
)

SELECT
    LISTAGG(
        '"' || PARTITION_ID || '"',
        ','
    )
    WITHIN GROUP
    (
        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN PARTITION_ID = 'INVALID'
                THEN 2
                ELSE 1
            END,
            PARTITION_ID
    ) AS PARTITION_LIST
FROM RESULT_PARTITION
WITH UR

INSERT INTO "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_target_master
(
    data_class,
    ingest_type,
    src_type,
    src_db_nm,
    src_schema_nm,
    src_table_nm,
    cdc_tgt_db_nm,
    cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
    partition_clause,
    exec_group,
    condition_type,
    condition_frequency,
    condition_interval,
    incr_column_nm,
    incr_column_type,
    incr_column_hw_val,
    last_success_dt,
    delete_yn,
    init_wait_yn,
    created_by,
    created_dt,
    update_by,
    update_dt
)
SELECT
    data_class,
    ingest_type,
    src_type,
    src_db_nm,
    src_schema_nm,
    src_table_nm,
    cdc_tgt_db_nm,
    cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
    partition_clause,
    exec_group,
    condition_type,
    condition_frequency,
    condition_interval,
    incr_column_nm,
    incr_column_type,
    incr_column_hw_val,

    NULL                        AS last_success_dt,
    'N'                         AS delete_yn,
    init_wait_yn,
    created_by,
    created_dt,
    NULL                        AS update_by,
    NULL                        AS update_dt

FROM "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_target_master_staging
WHERE pipeline_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}';

UPDATE "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
SET
    ingest_pipeline_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}',
    status                 = 'RUNNING',
    start_dt               = NOW(),
    attempt_no             = attempt_no + 1,
    update_by              = 'ADF',
    update_dt              = NOW()
WHERE master_run_id       = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'
  AND ingest_pipeline_id  = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_ingest_pipeline_id}';

UPDATE "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
SET
    status    = 'FAILED',
    ingest_pipeline_run_id  ='@{pipeline().RunId}',
    error_log = 	 NULLIF(
        '@{replace(activity('Copy data').output.errors[0].Message,'''','''''')}',
        ''
    ),
    end_dt    = NOW(),
    update_by = 'ADF',
    update_dt = NOW()
WHERE master_run_id      = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'
  AND ingest_pipeline_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_ingest_pipeline_id}';

UPDATE "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
SET
    status    = 'SUCCEEDED',
    extract_cnt  = @{activity('Copy data').output.rowsRead},
    save_cnt     = @{activity('Copy data').output.rowsCopied},
    file_size_mb = @{div(activity('Copy data').output.dataWritten,1048576)},
    end_dt    = NOW(),
    update_by = 'ADF',
    update_dt = NOW()
WHERE master_run_id      = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'
  AND ingest_pipeline_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_ingest_pipeline_id}';

UPDATE "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
SET
    ingest_pipeline_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}',
    status                 = 'RUNNING',
    start_dt               = NOW(),
    attempt_no             = attempt_no + 1,
    update_by              = 'ADF',
    update_dt              = NOW()
WHERE master_run_id       = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'
  AND ingest_pipeline_id  = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_ingest_pipeline_id}';

UPDATE "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
SET
    status    = 'FAILED',
    ingest_pipeline_run_id  ='@{pipeline().RunId}',
    error_log = 	 NULLIF(
        '@{replace(activity('Copy data').output.errors[0].Message,'''','''''')}',
        ''
    ),
    end_dt    = NOW(),
    update_by = 'ADF',
    update_dt = NOW()
WHERE master_run_id      = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'
  AND ingest_pipeline_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_ingest_pipeline_id}';

UPDATE "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
SET
    status    = 'SUCCEEDED',
    extract_cnt  = @{activity('Copy data').output.rowsRead},
    save_cnt     = @{activity('Copy data').output.rowsCopied},
    file_size_mb = @{div(activity('Copy data').output.dataWritten,1048576)},
    end_dt    = NOW(),
    update_by = 'ADF',
    update_dt = NOW()
WHERE master_run_id      = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'
  AND ingest_pipeline_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_ingest_pipeline_id}';
